summary: Pampa Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of the Hidroelectrica Los Nihuiles S.A. (HINISA) hydroelectric concession on July 31, 2026, upon expiration of the transition period under the Concession Agreement with the Province of Mendoza. A Handover Certificate for the concession assets was executed between HINISA as concessionaire and the Province as grantor, formalizing asset delivery per contractual and regulatory provisions. This is a regulatory/contractual restructuring event rather than a market transaction, with no financial terms disclosed. watch for potential compensation claims or asset transfer disputes.
